image_description: A modern interior staircase featuring a curved wooden handrail supported by a glass balustrade system. The handrail is smooth, light-colored wood, curving gently along the stair incline. Instead of traditional vertical balusters, the railing uses transparent glass panels held in place by metal clamps or a continuous metal channel. In the background, there is a perforated metal ceiling or soffit and another level of the building visible through the glass.
